Colonnes : une carte se pose sur une car: Columns: a card goes on a card one rank higher and of the other colour (a red 7 on a black 8). An empty column only takes a King. Foundations (top right): from Ace to King, in the same suit. When everything is face up, the game finishes by itself.
Toutes les cartes sont visibles. En colo: All cards are visible. In columns: one rank lower, of the other colour. The 4 free cells (top left) hold one card each; you can move as many cards at once as the free cells and empty columns allow. Foundations top right, from Ace to King. Almost every deal can be won.
Deux jeux, une seule couleur. Une carte: Two decks, one suit. A card goes on a card one rank higher; a run of the same suit moves as a block. A full run from King to Ace is removed. The stock (top left) deals one card to each column, when none is empty.
Deux jeux, deux couleurs (pique et cœur): Two decks, two suits (spades and hearts). A card goes on a card one rank higher, of any suit, but only a run of the same suit moves as a block. A full run from King to Ace is removed. The stock deals one card to each column, when none is empty.
spider : deux couleurs d’un bloc: spider: two suits as a block
Le solitaire classique (Klondike) : rang: Classic solitaire (Klondike): sort the 52 cards into the four foundations from Ace to King by moving them between seven columns, in descending order and alternating colours. Drag cards or click to send them to the best place, draw one or three cards, undo without limit; automatic finish, time, moves and best time kept. A button switches the game to full screen, and the table grows with the window. Also FreeCell and Spider (one or two suits), and bouncing cards when you win.
